provision.quote: Determination of Tax, Interest: and penalty. Under section 73 of TNGST ACT.2017

date.quote: An assessment order dated 28.12.2023 is the subject of challenge.

events.quote: In those circumstances, the petitioner states that a notice in Form GST ASMT-10 was received in July 2023.

As requested by the taxpayer a personal hearing was offered on 21.12.2023 and their representative Mr.Gajendra panda (Branch Manager), Chennai had attended the same and he stated that as this registered person is GTA the entire turnover is under RCM which is to be paid by recipient of service only.
The impugned order was issued thereafter on 28.12.2023.

document_contents.quote: By such reply, the petitioner asserted that the entire turnover is taxable under RCM basis on the recipient of service.
Further he did not produce any relevant document in respect of tamilnadu branch like P & L, purchase, sales details, balance sheet and ITR details.

It is also observed that on verification of the GSTR-1 Table-8 GSTR-3B Table 3.1 (C) and GSTR-9 Part-II, 5D it is found that the resisted tax payer has not declared their GTA related service turnover in the mentioned tables above.

On verification of all india balance sheet it is found that other income was reported amounted to Rs.20,05,359.00 as per Note- 8 on which excluding an interest a sum of Rs.284201.30 was declared which is liable for tax @ 18%.

defects_argued.quote: Therefore, the impugned assessment order is undoubtedly vitiated by non application of mind.
Although the petitioner had submitted the balance sheet and ITR details, it is evident from the above extract that the assessing officer recorded findings contrary to the documents on record.

outcome.quote: For reasons set out above, the impugned assessment order is quashed and the matter is remanded for re-consideration.
